sidebar.subline: Walk through a few short steps to finish setting up your StellarCrew instance.
sidebar.localPreview: Local preview — nothing is sent outside your instance.

api.unreachableBody: The install status endpoint is unavailable. Make sure the backend is running and reachable.
api.homeApiHint: Could not reach the API. Make sure the backend is running.
api.serverRejected: The server rejected the submitted values. Double-check your admin credentials.
api.alreadyInstalledMessage: The system has already been installed.
api.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

alreadyInstalled.heading: System already installed
alreadyInstalled.body: An administrator has already been provisioned. Head back to the application to sign in.

complete.heading: You are all set{{greeting}}.
complete.body: Your StellarCrew instance is installed. Head to the app to sign in and meet your crew.

login.title: Sign in to StellarCrew
login.description: Use the admin account created during installation.
login.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

admin.label: Admin & profile
admin.title: Create your administrator account
admin.description: Credentials for the first administrator and how we should greet you in the app.
admin.sectionSubheading: This account can sign in and manage every workspace in your instance.
admin.displayNameHint: Shown in greetings across the app, e.g. “Welcome, Tomek”.

errors.password: Password must have at least 10 characters

branding.label: Branding
branding.title: Make it yours
branding.description: Set the instance name, colours and locale so your crew feels at home.
branding.sectionSubheading: Instance name, default locale and colour accents.
branding.placeholderBody: Fields for instance name and default locale will land here. For now you can skip ahead — defaults will be applied.

logo.label: Logo
logo.title: Upload your logo
logo.description: A logo shown in the top bar and on emails. You can replace it any time.
logo.sectionSubheading: PNG or SVG works best. You can replace it any time from the admin panel.
logo.skipHint: You can also skip this step — a generic mark will be used until you upload one.

workspace.label: First workspace
workspace.title: Set up your first workspace
workspace.description: Workspaces are where projects, agents and knowledge live. Start with one.
workspace.sectionSubheading: Workspaces group a project, its data and its agents. You can always add more later.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.nameHint: You can rename it at any time from the workspace settings.
workspace.agentsSubheading: Pick who joins first. More agents and custom roles can be added later — this is a placeholder, nothing is provisioned yet.

review.label: Review
review.title: Review and finish
review.description: Quick look before we provision your instance. Jump back to any step if needed.
review.sectionSubheading: Quick look before we finalise. You can jump back to any completed step on the left.
